name: gpt-image-2
description: Image generation with OpenAI gpt-image-2 — works in Claude Code and Claude Cowork

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key with gpt-image-2 access. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Your organization must be verified to use the gpt-image family.

OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL.title: Model ID (optional)
OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL.description: Override the model. Leave blank to use gpt-image-2.

MCP_GPT_IMAGE_2_OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output directory (optional)
MCP_GPT_IMAGE_2_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Where to save generated images. Defaults to ./generated_imgs in the current working directory.

MCP_GPT_IMAGE_2_INLINE_IMAGE.title: Return inline image data by default (optional)
MCP_GPT_IMAGE_2_INLINE_IMAGE.description: Set to "false" to skip embedding base64 image data in tool responses (saves context window). Defaults to "true".
